# Bruinet API changes

What a project using Bruinet must change, per change. `Find` is a regex for consumer code
(`*.cs`, and where noted `*.feature`, `*.steps`, `*.config`, `*.json`).

## Made

Newest first. Apply oldest first.

| Commit | Change | Find | Write instead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 52ca2c89 | `TimeoutSettings`' six members (`DefaultWait`, `PageLoad`, `ElementFind`, `ElementState`, `Animation`, `PollingInterval`) and `With(...)` take `TimeSpan`, not `int` milliseconds; `TimeSpan.ToMs()` (`Bruinet.Core.Configuration`) gives a verb its `int? timeoutMs`. Control verbs keep `int? timeoutMs` (review proposal 9) | `\bTimeouts\.(DefaultWait\|PageLoad\|ElementFind\|ElementState\|Animation\|PollingInterval)\b` read as a number; `new TimeoutSettings` with numbers; `\.With\((defaultWait\|pageLoad\|elementFind\|elementState\|animation\|pollingInterval):` | `TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(n)` where a number was set; `.ToMs()` where one is read into a verb's `timeoutMs`; settings JSON keeps its numbers of milliseconds (or takes `"00:00:05"`) |
